audio_description:
Zell Dincht throws punches at the Garden's ornate gate.
Zell leaps high into the air before the gate.
Zell faces the blue Garden emblem.

context.scene_title: Zell Dincht character introduction — part of the early Disc 1 'Balamb Garden' montage introducing the cast.
locations: Balamb Garden main gate / entrance archway, beneath the Garden (SeeD) crest

characters.name: Zell Dincht
characters.recognition: Energetic young man with bright spiky blonde hair, a tribal tattoo on the left side of his face, fingerless gloves; a martial-artist cadet who strikes punching/jumping poses. Seen here in a dark uniform at the Garden gate.

context.summary: A brief character-introduction clip for Zell Dincht. He bounds around energetically at the front gate of Balamb Garden, throwing martial-arts punches and jumps beneath the ornate Garden crest, then is shown from behind gazing up at the blue Garden emblem. It establishes his hyperactive, fighter personality.
